description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the "Avg. JGA Score" across various "Turn ID" categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled "Turn ID," which are ordered numerically in increments of 2, starting from 0 and ending at 26. The vertical value axis is labeled "Avg. JGA Score" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 0.1. The chart displays data using grouped bars for each Turn ID, with each group consisting of two adjacent bars. According to the legend in the upper right, the orange bars correspond to a label that is visually obscured by a gray rectangular artifact, while the yellow bars represent "T5-small." The orange bars exhibit a general downward trend, decreasing in height from a maximum of approximately 0.96 at Turn ID 0 to a minimum of roughly 0.45 at Turn ID 26. Similarly, the yellow "T5-small" bars show a decreasing trend, starting at their tallest value of about 0.95 at Turn ID 0 and reaching their shortest value of approximately 0.3 at Turn ID 24, before ending at roughly 0.33 at Turn ID 26. The categories on the horizontal axis are sorted in ascending numerical order, and aside from the obscured legend text, no specific bars are visually emphasized with outlines or bolding.
